title: TactiRise trading handbook rules
disclaimer: Educational research for a paper-trading system. Not financial advice. No rule here is a promise of profit. The code's risk limits always win over this file.
notes: Reference data only. Nothing in the worker reads this file to decide or size a trade, and it is not part of PAPER_REVIEWED_CONFIG_HASH.
Derek's rules come first. Each rule names where it came from and whether main enforces it.

status: enforced = main does it; enforced_stricter = main does something tighter; partial = main covers part of it; differs = main does something different; not_on_main = only in draft PR #14; in_profile_off = implemented in an opt-in day-trade profile that is OFF by default (DAY_TRADE_PROFILE), so main's default strategy does not use it yet; guidance = research advice, not code; informational = background fact.

rules.title: Paper trading only
rules.rule: Never trade real money or enable a live mode. Stocks and crypto use the Alpaca paper host; forex uses the OANDA practice host only.

rules.title: AI trades use the same risk checks
rules.rule: An AI-chosen trade becomes a normal deterministic order intent and must pass the unchanged risk manager. AI cannot skip or loosen a limit.
rules.note: Only active when AI_ADVISOR_MODE=cotrade. Today the worker runs advise (watch-only).

rules.title: Outside text cannot change limits
rules.rule: Web pages, news or model output cannot change active strategies, credentials or risk limits, and no strategy is called proven without evidence.
rules.note: Limits live in code and reviewed config; this handbook is read-only text.

rules.title: Long only
rules.rule: Buy-side entries only. No shorting.

rules.title: Day trades only, flat by the close
rules.rule: Open and close every position the same New York session; flatten from 10 minutes before the close (earlier on early-close days).
rules.note: Off-by-default profile large_cap_day_trade_v1 flattens from 15:50 ET, or close-10 min on early-close days (13:00 close -> 12:50), and liquidates prior-day positions after the open. Main's default still exits at 15:45 ET and is not early-close aware.

rules.title: Regular-session entries, extended_hours off
rules.rule: Enter only in the regular session and send entries with extended_hours=false.
rules.note: The profile ignores extended-hours bars and its intents carry extended_hours=false. Main's default alpaca.py still sends extended_hours=true; the profile's hash block records entry_extended_hours=false and the wiring PR must honour it.

rules.title: Nothing before 09:45 ET
rules.rule: No new setups before 09:45 ET (15-minute opening range must finish first).
rules.note: In the profile nothing arms before 09:45 ET. Main's default allows entries from 09:35 ET.

rules.title: Arming windows
rules.rule: ORB 09:45-09:50; ORB or VWAP 09:50-10:45; VWAP 10:45-11:30; nothing 11:30-13:30; VWAP 13:30-15:00; no new setups after 15:00 ET.
rules.note: Profile only. Also no new buys after 15:30 ET (close-30 min on early-close days).

rules.title: Two setups only
rules.rule: Trade only a 15-minute opening-range-breakout retest and a trend-aligned VWAP pullback. Consolidation breakouts are logged, not traded. No mean reversion or scalping.
rules.note: Profile only (ORB has priority if both fire). Main's default still trades the liquid_large_cap_iex_v2 first-pullback breakout.

rules.title: Trade only an UP regime
rules.rule: Only an UP regime (efficiency, VWAP slope and closes above VWAP) arms new setups. AAPL and MSFT also need SPY above its VWAP with a non-decreasing 5-minute VWAP.
rules.note: Profile only. DOWN cancels a setup; CHOP does not.

rules.title: Max $25 risk per trade
rules.rule: Hard max planned risk of $25 per trade (also 0.025% of a reference equity capped at $100k).
rules.note: The $25 cap is enforced. The off-by-default large-cap profile also applies 0.025% of E_ref = min(session equity, $100k), never above RiskConfig.

rules.title: Stop for the day at -$75
rules.rule: Halt new entries for the day once the day's net loss reaches $75.

rules.title: Position size caps
rules.rule: Max $2,500 per symbol, $5,000 gross, $50 committed open risk including pending entries, max 2 positions.
rules.note: Main caps each position at $1,000 and allows only one open equity position or open order at a time, so gross, open risk and count are all tighter. The large-cap profile takes the stricter of its spec and RiskConfig, so it inherits $1,000 and one position.

rules.title: Whole shares, no margin
rules.rule: Whole shares only; never use margin.
rules.note: Notional is capped at min(max_notional, equity), so no leverage is used.

rules.title: Size from stop distance plus costs
rules.rule: Shares = floor(min(trade risk left / d, portfolio risk left / d, symbol allowance left / P, exposure left / P)) with d = P - S + c and c = max($0.02, 0.0002 x P). Skip if under 1 share.
rules.note: The profile sizes with c = max($0.02, 0.0002 x P) and never below RiskConfig's allowance. Main's default RiskManager still uses a fixed $0.02.

rules.title: ATR-based entries and stops
rules.rule: 1-minute bars, 14-bar ATR, 15-bar warmup. Entry limit = signal close + 0.20 ATR with a 60-second time-to-live. Stop distance must be 0.75-2.5 ATR.
rules.note: Profile only. Main's default enters at the ask (max $0.03 chase), TTL 15 s, stop at pullback low - $0.01.

rules.title: Target 2R
rules.rule: Profit target at +2R.

rules.title: No-progress and max-hold exits
rules.rule: Exit at 10 minutes if the trade is below +0.5R. Max hold 45 minutes.
rules.note: Profile only. Main's default exits every trade at 10 minutes.

rules.title: Relative volume is logged, not a gate
rules.rule: Record RVOL but do not require it. Prior-close % gain is context only. No float, price-band or catalyst gates for large caps.
rules.note: Profile only (RVOL logged, no float/price/catalyst gate). Main's default liquid v2 requires RVOL >= 1.2 and gain >= 0.10%.

rules.title: Cooldowns after a trade
rules.rule: Wait 10 minutes after a win or breakeven and 15 minutes after a loss before the same symbol re-arms.
rules.note: Profile only. Counters persist across restarts via to_state().

rules.title: Campaign caps
rules.rule: At most 3 campaigns per symbol per day, disable a symbol after 2 losing campaigns, at most 6 campaigns per day bot-wide.
rules.note: Profile only. Also max 1 filled ORB per symbol per day.

rules.title: No partials or scale-ins by default
rules.rule: Partial exits and adding to positions stay off unless explicitly turned on. Never average down.
rules.note: Main cannot add to a position at all: any open position or order blocks new entries.

rules.title: Ross: five-factor stock filter
rules.rule: Only trade stocks priced $2-$20 with float under 20M shares, relative volume >= 5x, up >= 10% today and a fresh news catalyst. Top-5 gainers preferred (logged).
rules.note: ross_cameron_small_cap_v1 only, which is hard-gated off until float, news and full-market scanner data exist. Left out of the AI prompt while the profile is gated.

rules.title: Ross: Gap and Go
rules.rule: 09:30-10:00 ET on a > 4% gap with a catalyst: buy the break of the premarket high, or a 1-minute opening-range breakout with the stop at the first candle's low.
rules.note: Completed 1-minute bars only (Ross enters intrabar). Left out of the AI prompt while the profile is gated.

rules.title: Ross: bull flag
rules.rule: After a strong green impulse, 2-3 red pullback candles (4+ rejected), retrace <= 50%, pullback holds VWAP: buy the break of the last red candle's high, stop at the pullback low, about 2:1. A 9-EMA break is a warning.
rules.note: Window 09:30-11:30 ET. Wide stops over $0.20/share are skipped (Ross example). Left out of the AI prompt while the profile is gated.

rules.title: Ross: half off at the first target
rules.rule: Sell half at the first target (+2R), then move the stop on the rest to the entry price.
rules.note: Unlike the large-cap profile, partials are part of this method. Left out of the AI prompt while the profile is gated.

rules.title: Ross: first red candle exit
rules.rule: Exit when a 1-minute candle closes red.
rules.note: ross_cameron_small_cap_v1 only (hard-gated). Left out of the AI prompt while the profile is gated.

rules.title: Ross: stop after 3 losses in a row
rules.rule: Stop trading for the day after three consecutive losing trades, and at the daily max loss.
rules.note: Daily max loss is the stricter of Ross's setting and RiskConfig ($75). Left out of the AI prompt while the profile is gated.

rules.title: Ross: needs paid-grade data
rules.rule: The method needs share float, news catalysts and a full-market gainers scan on a SIP feed. Without all of them the profile refuses to trade.
rules.note: No provider implementation ships. Data costs need Derek's yes. Left out of the AI prompt while the profile is gated.

rules.title: Ross: our caps win
rules.rule: Ross's own sizing is clamped by our global limits: $25 risk per trade, $75 a day, $1,000 notional, one open stock position.
rules.note: ross_cameron_small_cap_v1 only (hard-gated). Left out of the AI prompt while the profile is gated.

rules.title: Expect most day trading to lose
rules.rule: Treat results as learning. Large studies find about 97% of persistent day traders lost money and under 1% earned reliable profits after fees.

rules.title: Stop first, then size
rules.rule: Define the stop before entry and size from the distance to it so a stop-out loses a fixed small amount (1R).

rules.title: Small risk per trade
rules.rule: Risk at most about 1% of equity per trade; smaller is safer while a strategy is unproven.
rules.note: Stocks $25 per trade on a ~$100k paper account (0.025%).

rules.title: Daily loss stop on every market
rules.rule: A daily loss limit halts new entries until the next session.

rules.title: Count every cost
rules.rule: Include spread, slippage and fees. Reject an edge that disappears at double the assumed cost.
rules.note: Sizing includes a per-share cost allowance; the 2x-cost acceptance test is a Strategy Lab gate, not runtime code.

rules.title: Distrust a single good backtest
rules.rule: Test out of sample, count how many variants were tried, and demand stronger evidence (t-stat above 3) when many were tried.

rules.title: No trade on stale or wide quotes
rules.rule: Skip a signal when the quote is old or the spread is wide.

rules.title: Do not hold losers or average down
rules.rule: Investors tend to sell winners and keep losers (disposition effect). Let the stop act; never add to a loser.

rules.title: Trade less
rules.rule: Heavy trading lowers net returns for individuals. Cap trades per day.
rules.note: Only AI-only cotrade entries have a daily cap; see DR-21.

rules.title: PDT rule is gone
rules.rule: FINRA replaced the pattern day trader rule and its $25,000 minimum with intraday margin standards on 2026-06-04 (phase-in to 2027-10-20). Alpaca removed PDT checks. Paper accounts were never subject to it.

rules.title: Low effective leverage
rules.rule: US retail forex allows up to 50:1 on majors; most retail leveraged accounts lose. Keep effective leverage near 2x and always use a stop.
rules.note: OANDA practice orders are off until Derek's token and account ID are on Render.

rules.title: Respect forex sessions and rollover
rules.rule: Liquidity is best in the London-New York overlap (about 08:00-12:00 ET). Avoid the 16:59-17:05 ET rollover, Sunday open and big news when spreads widen.
rules.note: The 15 bps spread cap blocks most wide-spread moments; there is no session-time filter.

rules.title: Crypto fees are large for short trades
rules.rule: Alpaca charges 0.15-0.25% per side at the lowest tier, so a round trip can cost up to about 0.5% before spread. A target smaller than that loses money.
rules.note: The live crypto rule enters after a +0.5% rise and stops at -1%; it has no explicit take-profit check against fees.

rules.title: Crypto momentum evidence is weekly, not tick
rules.rule: Published crypto momentum is at daily-to-weekly horizons. Do not assume it holds over seconds.

rules.title: Journal every decision
rules.rule: Record every entry, exit and rejection with its reason, then review by R-multiple, setup and time of day.
rules.note: The journal records decisions; there is no automatic weekly R-multiple review yet.

rules.title: Intraday momentum evidence is mixed
rules.rule: SPY's first half-hour return predicted its last half-hour in 1993-2013, and a 2024 SPY intraday-momentum paper reports gains, but an independent 2015-2026 replication found no US effect after costs. Treat it as unproven.

rules.title: VWAP is a reference, not a signal
rules.rule: VWAP began as a benchmark for execution cost. Use it to judge trend and fair price, alongside price action and risk limits, not as a buy signal on its own.

rules.title: Gap-and-go is unvalidated
rules.rule: Momentum profits tend to accrue overnight, not intraday. No peer-reviewed evidence was found that retail gap-and-go entries are profitable after costs.
